conclusions: The synthesized top has fixed parameters; direct RTL instance parameter overrides must not be passed blindly to its functional netlist.

Existing scoreboard, coverage, task decisions and fault injection conditions depend on internal RTL hierarchy, not only observer printouts. Removing hierarchical statements would change verification semantics.
A gate validation entry must preserve externally driven transactions, negative-case decisions and expected responses; any internal diagnostics that cannot be mapped need explicit coverage accounting.

Port stimulus replay can test the complete recorded run if input timing and all output comparisons are preserved, but it does not independently reproduce adaptive closed-loop stimulus or replace the original behavioral monitors.
